title: Your brain thinks your worst day is this. It is not.
hook: Your brain plans for a bad day. The market plans for a worse one.

meme.setup: Me: a bad day costs me {var95}, tops

meme.truth: {var95} is where bad days start, not where they end. Past it, the average loss is {cvar95}.

takeaway: Plan for the tail, not for the threshold.
caption: VaR tells you where bad days begin. CVaR tells you how bad they get. Simulated fat-tailed returns, fixed seed.
